mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_remote_generation_job(id, submission_id, item_id, item_index, model_id, actor_user_id, project_id, state, phase, input_json, next_poll_at, deadline_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.submissionId}, #{row.itemId}, #{row.itemIndex}, #{row.modelId}, #{row.actorUserId}, #{row.projectId}, 'QUEUED', 'NEW', #{row.inputJson}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, 2, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT id, model_id, actor_user_id, project_id, phase, permit_held, cancel_requested FROM afv_remote_generation_job WHERE ((state IN ('READY', 'WAITING') AND next_poll_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY next_poll_at, id LIMIT 128 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET next_poll_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 2, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_remote_generation_job WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET state = 'WAITING', phase = #{phase}, lease_until = NULL, next_poll_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{seconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), poll_attempts = poll_attempts + 1, consecutive_errors = #{errors}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET result_json = #{result}, phase = 'INGESTING', permit_held = FALSE, consecutive_errors = 0, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET active_attempt_id = #{attemptId}, phase = 'PREPARING', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, phase = 'SUBMITTING', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, result_json = #{result}, phase = #{phase}, permit_held = #{permitHeld}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET state = #{state}, lease_until = NULL, error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET state = #{state}, phase = 'FINISHED', permit_held = FALSE, lease_until = NULL, error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET cancel_requested = TRUE, next_poll_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), revision = revision + 1 WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} AND state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM afv_remote_generation_job WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_remote_generation_job SET state = 'READY', phase = 'NEW', active_attempt_id = NULL, provider_task_id = NULL, result_json = NULL, cancel_sent = FALSE, permit_held = FALSE, next_poll_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), deadline_at = TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, 2, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), consecutive_errors = 0, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
